question.worked_solution:
We start by using the power of product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{({a}^{2}b)}^{3}\cdot ab=({a}^{2})^{3}\cdot {b}^{3}\cdot ab & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we use the power rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}({a}^{2})^{3}\cdot {b}^{3}\cdot ab & = \\ {a}^{2\cdot 3}\cdot {b}^{3}\cdot ab & = \\ {a}^{6}\cdot {b}^{3}\cdot ab & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we use the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}^{6}\cdot {b}^{3}\cdot ab & = \\ ({a}^{6}\cdot a)\cdot ({b}^{3}\cdot b) & = \\ {a}^{6+1}\cdot {b}^{3+1} & = \\ {a}^{7}\cdot {b}^{4} & = \\ {a}^{7}{b}^{4} & \end{aligned}
$$
